description: Port of Clippy 0.1.99's option_env_unwrap: reports an unwrap or expect call on option_env!, spanning the whole call; inside a token tree (a macro invocation's input or a macro_rules! body) it reports the call where its tokens are written, as Clippy does for macros that keep their input's spans (macro_rules!, format macros) and for a macro_rules! body that is expanded; a proc macro that respans its input, which Clippy reports at the invocation, is not modelled.

violation.message: Replace this unwrapped option_env! with env! so a missing variable fails the build, not the run.
Clippy option_env_unwrap: option_env! should not be unwrapped
